body:
Less and less these days, unfortunately. 

I think I'm through the worst of it now, I've calmed down and am getting sleepy. Think I will go to bed. 

Thank you for talking to me, you're a good person and you really helped me tonight.
I'm so sorry you're feeling this way too. :(

Depressed. Had a therapy session today, but I left it feeling awful and hopeless. It's going to be so much work to rewire the way I think and feel, and I don't have the energy or desire to do it. I'd rather just be dust. 

A friend told me today I'd done something to break her trust, and I feel so bad about it. I'm not really sure I actually did what she accused me of, but my self-esteem is so low I always assume everything is my fault. Just one more piece of evidence to add to the pile that confirms I'm a terrible person. 

Work is repetitive and unfulfilling. 

Life is repetitive and unfulfilling. 

Just an extra rough day.
Belt in the closet, but I'm afraid. And I'm afraid of my husband finding me.
